title: On structural properties of some probable $R(3, 10)$-critical graphs
summary: The Ramsey number $R(s, t)$ is the smallest positive integer $n$ such that every graph on $n$ vertices contains either a clique of size $s$ or an independent set of size $t$. An $R(s,t)$-critical graph is a graph on $R(s,t)-1$ vertices that contains neither a clique of size $s$ nor an independent set of size $t$. It is known that $40\leq R(3, 10)\leq 42$. We study the structure of a $R(3,10)$-critical graphs by assuming $R(3, 10)=42$. We show that if such a graph exists then its minimum degree and vertex connectivity are the same and is $6, 7$ or $8$.
